title: Repair native-memory source export and stage signed three-model release
body:
The native primitive can repeat a record when recall sections overlap, which makes the new plugins reject a populated source view. This repair deduplicates immutable owner/record identities, refuses revision/content conflicts across the complete view, and returns the first 32 unique records. Ordinary recall and authorization retain their existing paths.

The change also stages signed v0.3.2 build-2 metadata for three dedicated model plugins and their shared runtime, supplies asset verification and draft-release tooling, and updates the README and current guides against the voice guide. All five wheel identities and seven Ed25519 signatures verify; wheel bytes and signing material stay outside Git history. PR #3003's title and description now reflect 1.0.0 and the separate native release.

Validation: full native server build; HTTP/authentication and CLI tests; registered projection tests with ASan, UBSan and leak checks; four release-verifier regression tests; all 75 lint checks; generated references, application source-lock and refactor-baseline checks. Two mutable CLI parser pointers retain their argv type for C23 compatibility. Historical module pins and GPU candidate bytes are unchanged.

Application release-image qualification and public native-plugin download/install remain delivery checks. The signed payload is ready for a draft prerelease; this workspace still needs release-write API authentication to upload it.
head: fix/native-memory-032-release
